_note: Landing-page facts. Only statements that are true of the live store or generally true of cross-border parcels may appear here. No transit days, no shipping prices, no guarantees. Recommended practice: a market is indexable only after its evidence gate passes (see tools/audit-market-locale-readiness.mjs: indexableCountryLandingAllowed) and a native speaker has reviewed each language. On 2026-11-20 the site owner overrode that gate for all five markets; each `evidence` field records the override. Set `indexable` to false to withdraw a market.

markets.name: Germany
markets.evidence: OWNER OVERRIDE 2026-11-20: made indexable at the site owner's instruction. No verified shipping, checkout, tax or returns evidence is on file for this country, and the non-English copy has not been reviewed by a native speaker. Content is limited to general, hedged guidance.
markets.intro: Order from Sasta Milaga's global supplier collection and have it delivered to a German address. You choose the item and option, we confirm the shipping method and the total, and you pay by prepaid checkout before anything is ordered.
markets.tax: Germany is part of the EU single market. Parcels sent from outside the EU can be charged import VAT and, depending on the goods and their value, customs duty. Those charges are not included in the price you see on Sasta Milaga; the carrier or customs office tells you what is due.
markets.safety: Electrical goods, toys and cosmetics sold in the EU must meet EU product-safety rules, such as CE marking where it applies. Ask us about a specific item before you order it.
markets.question: Will I pay import VAT on an order delivered to Germany?
markets.answer: It can happen. Goods shipped from outside the EU are generally subject to import VAT, and customs duty can apply to some goods. Sasta Milaga's price does not include these charges, so allow for them and check current German customs guidance before you order.

markets.evidence: OWNER OVERRIDE 2026-11-20: made indexable at the site owner's instruction. No verified shipping, checkout, tax or returns evidence is on file for this country, and the non-English copy has not been reviewed by a native speaker. Content is limited to general, hedged guidance.
markets.intro: Order from Sasta Milaga's global supplier collection for delivery to a UK address. Pick the item and option, review the shipping method and the total we confirm with you, then pay by prepaid checkout.
markets.tax: Goods delivered to the UK from abroad can attract UK VAT and, for some goods, customs duty. These are not part of Sasta Milaga's displayed price. Check HMRC's current rules for goods you import and allow for any charge the carrier collects.
markets.safety: Some goods, such as electricals, toys and cosmetics, must carry UK product-safety markings. Ask us about the specific item before you order it.
markets.question: Are UK VAT and customs duty included in the price?
markets.answer: No. The price shown on Sasta Milaga is the item price estimate before shipping, taxes and duties. UK VAT or duty may be charged on delivery depending on the goods and their value, so check HMRC guidance for imported goods.

markets.name: the United States
markets.evidence: OWNER OVERRIDE 2026-11-20: made indexable at the site owner's instruction. No verified shipping, checkout, tax or returns evidence is on file for this country, and the non-English copy has not been reviewed by a native speaker. Content is limited to general, hedged guidance.
markets.intro: Order from Sasta Milaga's global supplier collection for delivery to a US address. Choose the item and option, we confirm the shipping method and total with you, and you pay by prepaid checkout before the order is placed.
markets.tax: Imported parcels can be subject to duties, taxes and carrier fees, and the US rules for low-value parcels have changed more than once. Sasta Milaga's price does not include them. Check current US Customs and Border Protection guidance before you order.
markets.safety: Some goods, such as electronics, toys, cosmetics and food contact items, must meet US safety and labelling rules. Ask us about the specific item before you order it.
markets.question: Do I pay import duty on an order delivered to the USA?
markets.answer: You may. Duties, taxes and carrier fees on imported parcels depend on the goods, their value and the rules in force when the parcel arrives. They are not included in Sasta Milaga's price, so check current US Customs and Border Protection guidance first.

markets.intro: Order from Sasta Milaga's global supplier collection for delivery to an address in Serbia. You pick the item and option, we confirm the shipping method and the total, and you pay by prepaid checkout. This page and our support are in English; there is no Serbian-language version yet.
markets.tax: Serbia is not in the EU, so parcels from abroad pass through Serbian customs. Customs duty and VAT can apply depending on the goods and their value, and the postal operator or courier will tell you what is due. These charges are not included in Sasta Milaga's price.
markets.safety: Some goods have labelling and conformity requirements in Serbia. Ask us about the specific item before you order it.
markets.question: Is customs duty included when I order to Serbia?
markets.answer: No. Serbia sits outside the EU customs area, so duty and VAT can be charged on delivery depending on the goods and their value. Sasta Milaga's displayed price is an item estimate before shipping, taxes and duties.
